candidates.change_summary: Replace the require overflow check with a failing require that always reverts when msg.value > 0, preventing balance changes.
Remove the addition to balances (delete the balances increment), so deposits satisfying the min are not recorded.
Change balances update to set balance to msg.value (overwriting previous balance) instead of adding, altering stored balances for callers and potentially other keys via reentrancy paths.

Move the TransferLog.AddMessage call before updating balances, so the log records the deposit before state change (observable ordering), and in presence of reentrancy could affect balances at other keys.
Change the if condition to require msg.value strictly greater than MinDeposit (>) so exact MinDeposit deposits are ignored and balances differ for callers depositing exactly MinDeposit.
